 Costera Sur Festival 2027 adds Marcelo Criminal, Pumuky and Sal del Coche: free in Los Garres on 16 and 17 April
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Pau 
 19 Nov 2026, 13:00 
 A 2-minute read 
 Costera Sur Festival (ilustración de Isa Muguruza) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Marcelo Criminal, Pumuky, Sal del Coche, Mirallo and Tristicis join Costera Sur 2027 , which now has nine names alongside Me Acuerdo de Todo, Nepal Nepal and Ricardo Lezón, the voice of McEnroe, with Jimena. 
 The festival will take place on Friday 16 and Saturday 17 April in Los Garres (Murcia) , in the plaza de la Iglesia in the San José neighbourhood, with more than 15 concerts and DJ sets from 12:30. 
 Entry is free until capacity is reached , and anyone who wishes can buy a charity ticket, from 5 to 30 euros, to reforest the area after the fire in June. 
 Costera Sur Festival now has nine names for its third edition. The free festival in Los Garres , at the foot of the Cresta del Gallo, has added Marcelo Criminal, Pumuky, Sal del Coche, Mirallo and Tristicis to a line-up that will take place on 16 and 17 April 2027 and that still charges no admission.
 The Costera Sur 2027 line-up, still open
 The organisers announced the second batch on 18 November on their social media. With it, the line-up currently stands as follows:
 First batch (October): Me Acuerdo de Todo, Nepal Nepal, Ricardo Lezón (McEnroe) & Jimena and the Mucha Movida DJ Set.
 Second batch (18 November): Marcelo Criminal, Mirallo, Pumuky, Sal del Coche and Tristicis.
 The festival speaks of more than 15 concerts, so there are still names to be announced, and it has not yet split the line-up by day or published set times. Marcelo Criminal returns: they already played at one of the two previous editions, according to C'mon Murcia, which also mentions Bernal and Agosto among the bands that have played the festival. The most established name is Ricardo Lezón, singer of McEnroe, who performs with Jimena. The illustrated poster is the work of Isa Muguruza.
 Where and when: plaza de San José, 16 and 17 April
 The concerts take place in the plaza de la Iglesia in the San José neighbourhood , in the Murcia district of Los Garres. The programme starts at 12:30 and combines concerts, DJ sets and the neighbourhood romería, according to the organisers. The times of each performance will be announced later.
 This is the third edition of a festival that began in 2025 and that, according to C'mon Murcia, reached capacity at its first two. With free entry and a square as the venue, capacity decides who gets in: arriving early is the only way to secure a place.
 Free, with an optional charity ticket
 Entry is free until capacity is reached . Since 15 October, the festival has also been selling optional charity tickets on Ingresse , priced at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30 euros , with a 2% booking fee. They are not needed to get in. According to the organisers, all proceeds go to the Junta Municipal de Los Garres for prevention and reforestation after the fire that hit the area in June.
 The rest of the region's events are in the listings of festivals in the Region of Murcia .
 Sources: Costera Sur Festival's official Instagram (posts of 22 September, 15 October and 18 November 2026) and its charity ticket page on Ingresse, consulted on 19 November 2026; C'mon Murcia (22 September, 1 October and 18 November 2026) and Notedetengas (18 November 2026).
